name: GroupQueryAttention
scope: Static attention/cache subgraph. WebNN has no fused attention; runtime sequence metadata is ignored and softcap/local-window modes are rejected. Fused backend kernels and the portable decomposition need not be bit-identical, so an immediately following dynamic quantizer can amplify legal rounding differences.

name: MatMulBnb4
scope: Packed NF4/FP4 block path where representable; incompatible tails become dense constants, losing low-bit memory/performance benefits.

name: MatMulNBits

name: MoE
scope: All experts execute densely because WebNN has no TopK or sparse dispatch. Approximate compute overhead is num_experts/k; supported activation/fusion forms only.

name: QMoE
scope: Supported 4/8-bit expert weights feed the same dense all-expert lowering; block-layout fallbacks may dequantize at conversion time.

name: SkipSimplifiedLayerNormalization
